items.title: AWS Shows Use of AI Agents to Triage Linux Kernel CVEs
items.summary: Engineers from Amazon Web Services (AWS) have described how the team that maintains the Linux kernel for EC2 infrastructure handles kernel CVEs. The process combines an automated filter, an AI agent and human review. The team also argues that it needs to move to newer long-term-support (LTS) kernels, as older branches collect fixes that are never backported. By Matt Saunders

items.title: Readyon Builds Four Layer Tenant Isolation for Multi Tenant Amazon EKS

items.title: Article: The Evolution of Agentic Harnesses: From Chains to Graph to Code
items.summary: Agentic LLM systems have moved from linear prompt chains to graph-based workflows and, more recently, code-executing harnesses. Chains are simple but fragile, graphs add branching, retries, and validation, and code harnesses verify outputs through execution. The article advises validating model outputs and choosing the least complex design that meets reliability, speed, and cost needs. By Karthik Ramgopal
